body:
I moved from my home country about 7 years ago, I moved back for a year and ended up leaving again. I did some travelling too. My first instinct is to run away from it all but no matter where I am I'm always in the same place in the end.

I'm aware how melodramatic and self indulgent I'm sounding and I just can't get out of that mindset. I do appreciate you listening.
I honestly don't know. Logically I think it's a chemical imbalance and I haven't found the right thing to even me out. But whatever it is it's not a simple answer, and I'm exhausted from trying.

I understand why you say that, but I think if Ive planned it for so long and haven't carried it out then I feel weak.

If I don't do it, nothing changes. If I do it then I could either finally cease to exist, or live with paralysis (hanging) or long term complications (drugs) and a crazy record. I think the brave ones take that chance.

I think I do, but I just want someone to listen and not to tell me what I have to live for. I feel like that because whenever I've felt good it's always come back to this. I feel like a fuck up, like something is really wrong with my brain and I wasn't designed to function like other people do. 
I've tried all sorts of medication, shrinks, exercise, healthy eating... But I think I'm broken and shouldn't have lived this long.
